question: A circular coil of radius $10 \text{ cm}$ having $500$ turns and resistance $2 \, \Omega$ is placed with its plane perpendicular to the horizontal component of the earth's magnetic field. It is rotated about its vertical diameter through $180^\circ$ in $0.25 \text{ s}$. Determine the magnitude of the average induced EMF. (Horizontal component of earth's field $B_H = 3.0 \times 10^{-5} \text{ T}$).
